regwatch_svc.faq_a1: RiskHub monitors the regulatory frameworks you already use and keeps your catalogue up to date automatically. It only notifies you when it needs your confirmation.
regwatch_svc.faq_q2: What do I have to configure?
regwatch_svc.faq_a2: Nothing beyond flipping the switch. The watched frameworks are derived automatically from what you use in RiskHub.
regwatch_svc.faq_q3: Does it legally interpret the regulations?
regwatch_svc.faq_a3: No. It detects and proposes changes; it does not certify nor replace your consultant or auditor.
regwatch_svc.faq_q4: What happens if I disable it?
regwatch_svc.faq_a4: You stop receiving notifications and your copies are not touched. You can re-enable it anytime without losing configuration.
regwatch_svc.faq_q5: Does it process personal data from my organization?
regwatch_svc.faq_a5: No. It only analyzes public regulatory documents using AI.
